title: UGREEN 25W MagFlow travel charger returns to its Prime Day price
summary: This UGREEN MagFlow charger is 50% off on Amazon, with Qi2 25W charging, MagSafe-friendly support, and a fold-flat design.
body: The UGREEN MagFlow 25W Pocket-Sized Foldable Wireless Charger is built for people who want a tidy Apple-friendly charging setup without carrying separate chargers for their phone and earbuds. It’s a pocket-sized, foldable 2-in-1 magnetic wireless charger that folds flat for travel, works as a small stand on a nightstand or desk, and it’s now down to a record-low price on Amazon. See the deal at Amazon
